purpose: Close the public-domain deployment divergence exposed by the pre50 attorney-demo live gate without weakening the qualified demo pathway.

officialRenderSources.finding: Custom domains must be added to the Render service, DNS configured, and domain verified; the service also retains its onrender.com hostname.
Deploy hooks support an exact Git commit through the ref query parameter.
RENDER_GIT_COMMIT, RENDER_GIT_BRANCH, RENDER_GIT_REPO_SLUG, RENDER_EXTERNAL_HOSTNAME, and RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL are available for runtime identity.
Web-service edge caching can cache eligible 200 responses by default; no-store disables caching; successful deploys invalidate Render edge cache entries.
Root custom domains must point to Render and AAAA records can cause unexpected behavior because Render uses IPv4.

decision: Add runtime release identity, no-store demo HTML, explicit last-known-good rollback authority, and dual-surface origin/public-domain convergence evidence. Do not weaken the pre50 attorney-demo content contract.
